title: The Anatomy of a Father: Faith, Character, and Legacy
summary: Anticipating the upcoming Father's Day, President Hughes unpacks the word 'FATHER' as an acronym to define true paternal leadership: Faith, Adversity, Teacher, Helper, Encouragement, and Reputation. He contrasts a humorous opening anecdote about an underappreciated father with a heartbreaking true story of a dad who chose golf over his son's Boy Scout campout. He challenges the elders to actively build a worthy reputation now and counsels the sisters to select future husbands based strictly on spiritual alignment and character, concluding with General Douglas MacArthur's famous wartime prayer for his son.
